rules.label: Primary and secondary text on raised-hover
Active-row indicator (accent leading bar) on highlight and selected fills
Secondary text on status soft fills (MetricChip labels on alert tones)

components.name: Button
components.summary: The action primitive: submit, confirm, cancel, provider sign-in, header and card actions, and toggles, in six variants and three sizes.
use: Any action that changes state or opens a flow: save, create, run, connect, delete.
Form submit, with busy while the request is in flight.
OAuth sign-in: a secondary Button with the brand mark in the leading slot (ProviderButton composition).
avoid: Navigation to another page: use Link, or buttonClasses() on an anchor when it must look like a button.
Icon-only controls: use IconButton, which requires a label.
Filters and tags: use Chip.
components.example:
<Button variant="primary" leading={Plus} busy={saving} onClick={create}>
  New policy
</Button>

components.name: IconButton
components.summary: Square, icon-only Button for toolbars and headers. Same skins and heights as Button; the label is required.
use: Toolbar and header actions where the glyph is unambiguous: copy, close, more, settings.
Toggles such as sidebar collapse or density, with pressed.
avoid: The action needs words to be understood: use Button with a leading icon.
Navigation: use a link.
components.example:
<Tooltip content="Copy run id" shortcut={['mod', 'c']}>
  <IconButton icon={Copy} label="Copy run id" onClick={copy} />
</Tooltip>

components.name: Link
components.summary: Navigation text: inline inside prose, or standalone in rows of actions and footers. External links open in a new tab and say so.
use: Moving to another page or document.
Inline references inside running text.
avoid: An action that does not navigate: use Button variant="link".
Primary page navigation: NavItem (Phase 3).
components.example:
<Link href="/docs/retention" variant="standalone" external>
  Retention policy
</Link>

components.name: Icon
components.summary: The one icon API: a lucide glyph at a token size with one 1.5px stroke. Decorative by default; give it a label when it carries meaning alone.
use: Any glyph in product UI.
Leading and trailing slots of controls (they accept the glyph directly).
avoid: Brand marks and illustrations: use an SVG asset.
A clickable glyph: IconButton.
components.example: <Icon icon={ShieldCheck} size="sm" className="text-at-fg-success" />

components.name: BrandMark
components.summary: Monochrome product marks lucide does not ship (Claude, Codex), at Icon token sizes in currentColor.
use: Provider and model identity next to its name: model picker, provider chip, agent rows.
avoid: Generic actions: use Icon with a lucide glyph.
OAuth sign-in buttons: OAuthButton owns its marks.
components.example: <BrandMark brand="claude" size="sm" />

components.name: Spinner
components.summary: Indeterminate progress: a 270 degree arc over a faint track in currentColor. Decorative inside busy controls, a status region when labeled.
use: Waits under about two seconds with no known length.
Inside a control: Button and IconButton busy use it for you.
avoid: Loading a layout: Skeleton (Batch D).
Long jobs with known progress: a progress bar.
components.example: <Spinner size="sm" label="Loading runs" />

components.name: Kbd
components.summary: A keyboard key or combo. Platform aware (mod is Command on Apple, Ctrl elsewhere) and spoken correctly by screen readers.
use: Shortcut hints in tooltips, menus, search triggers and docs.
avoid: Inline code or values: use code.
components.example: <Kbd keys={['mod', 'k']} />

components.name: Divider
components.summary: A 1px hairline, horizontal or vertical, optionally labeled (the "or" between sign-in options).
use: Separating groups inside a card, menu or toolbar.
The labeled "or" between alternatives.
avoid: Between page sections that already have headings and spacing.
components.example: <Divider label="or" />

components.name: Panel
components.summary: The card shell for a block of page content: card surface, default hairline, card radius, token padding, and an optional header with heading, description and actions.
use: A boxed section on a page: a chart, a list of fires, a settings group, a state specimen.
Any place a screen would otherwise write rounded-at-card border bg-at-surface-card by hand.
avoid: A KPI: use StatTile.
A table: DataTable draws its own card.
A clickable card: use a link or button with its own affordance (EventCard, PolicyCard).
components.example: <Panel title="Recent fires" description="Last 24 hours">...</Panel>

components.name: Badge
components.summary: A count or one-word marker next to a label. Neutral informs, accent asks for attention.
use: Unread or pending counts on nav items and tabs.
Row counts on tabs and group headers.
avoid: Status words: StatusBadge.
Removable or selectable values: Chip.
components.example: <Badge tone="accent" count={pending} label={`${pending} pending approvals`} />

components.name: StatusBadge
components.summary: A status word on a tinted plate: success, danger, warning, info, flag or neutral, soft or solid, with an optional dot or glyph.
use: Run, policy and agent status in tables, lists and headers.
variant="dot" in DataTable status columns (Active, Held), where a plate would compete with the row content.
avoid: Counts: Badge.
Interactive filters: Chip.
components.example: <StatusBadge tone="danger" dot>Blocked</StatusBadge>

components.name: Chip
components.summary: A compact token: a tag, a recipient, a value inside an input. Static, selectable (toggle), removable, or both, with 24px hit areas on a 20px chip.
use: Tags and recipients that can be removed.
Values inside an input (multi-select, recipients).
Selectable tokens inside content.
avoid: Toolbar filters: compose Button size="sm" (secondary, pressed) plus a remove IconButton so the filter matches control height (FilterChips, Phase 3).
Status: StatusBadge.
Counts: Badge.
components.example:
<Chip selectable selected={on} onSelectedChange={setOn}>Passed</Chip>
<Chip onRemove={() => remove(tag)}>{tag}</Chip>

components.name: Avatar
components.summary: A person or org mark: image with an initials fallback that shows while loading and after a failure, in six sizes and two shapes.
use: Message rows, account menus, member lists, run owners.
avoid: Agent or provider logos: brand marks (Phase 3 BrandMark).
components.example: <Avatar src={user.avatarUrl} name={user.name} size="lg" />

components.name: AvatarGroup
components.summary: Overlapping stack of circle avatars with a +N overflow tile.
use: Reviewers, members or participants in a row or header.
avoid: When each person needs to be read or clicked: a list.
components.example:
<AvatarGroup size="sm" max={4} label="6 reviewers">
  {reviewers.map((r) => <Avatar key={r.id} name={r.name} src={r.avatarUrl} />)}
</AvatarGroup>

components.name: Tooltip
components.summary: A short label on hover and keyboard focus, with an optional shortcut. Built on Base UI for positioning, flipping and dismissal.
use: Naming icon-only controls.
Revealing a shortcut.
avoid: Essential information or anything interactive: inline text or a Popover.
Touch-only surfaces: tooltips need hover or focus.
components.example:
<Tooltip content="Search" shortcut={['mod', 'k']}>
  <IconButton icon={Search} label="Search" />
</Tooltip>

components.name: Popover
components.summary: Non-modal floating panel anchored to a trigger, for filters, pickers and small forms. Base UI positioning, Escape and outside-click dismiss, no scrim.
use: Filters, pickers and short settings tied to one control.
Explaining a value in place when the explanation has a link or a control.
avoid: A list of actions: Menu.
A label for an icon: Tooltip.
A task that needs the user's full attention or more than 320px: Dialog or Drawer.
components.example:
<Popover
  trigger={<Button leading={SlidersHorizontal}>Filters</Button>}
  title="Filter runs"
>
  {filters}
  <PopoverClose><Button variant="primary">Apply</Button></PopoverClose>
</Popover>

components.name: Menu
components.summary: An action list anchored to a trigger: groups, separators, checkbox and radio items, submenus, shortcut hints, danger rows and typeahead. Base UI Menu.
use: Row and page actions behind a More button.
A small set of view options (checkbox or radio rows).
avoid: Choosing a form value: Select.
Navigation between pages: links or Tabs.
Forms or free content: Popover.
components.example:
<Menu trigger={<IconButton icon={MoreHorizontal} label="More actions" />} align="end">
  <MenuItem icon={Copy} shortcut={['mod', 'c']}>Copy run id</MenuItem>
  <MenuSeparator />
  <MenuItem icon={Trash2} tone="danger">Delete run</MenuItem>

components.name: Dialog
components.summary: Modal dialog with a scrim, sizes sm md lg, header, body and footer slots. Base UI Dialog: focus trap and return, scroll lock, Escape and outside-click dismiss.
use: A short task that blocks the page until done: create a key, rename, invite.
Content that needs full attention but not a page.
avoid: Confirming a destructive action: AlertDialog.
Inspecting a row next to its list: Drawer.
Long or multi-page work: a page.
components.example:
<Dialog
  trigger={<Button variant="primary">New API key</Button>}
  title="Create API key"
  footer={<>
    <DialogClose><Button>Cancel</Button></DialogClose>
    <Button variant="primary" onClick={create}>Create key</Button>
  </>}
>
  {f

components.name: AlertDialog
components.summary: Confirmation for destructive or irreversible actions (role alertdialog). Never dismissed by an outside click; focus starts on Cancel; a returned promise shows busy.
use: Delete, revoke, publish to production: anything costly to undo.
avoid: Undoable actions: act, then offer Undo in a Toast.
Forms: Dialog.
components.example:
<AlertDialog
  trigger={<Button variant="danger">Delete policy</Button>}
  title='Delete "PII egress block"?'
  description="This cannot be undone."
  confirmLabel="Delete policy"
  onConfirm={() => deletePolicy(id)}
/>

components.name: Drawer
components.summary: Side sheet from the right for peek and inspector views. Modal with a scrim by default; modal={false} is the peek: no scrim, the list stays clickable.
use: Peek a row next to the list it came from (modal={false}).
Inspect or edit one object without leaving the page (inspector).
avoid: Short blocking tasks: Dialog.
Deep work or anything shareable by URL: a page.
components.example:
<Drawer
  open={open}
  onOpenChange={setOpen}
  modal={false}
  title="Run blocked"
  description={run.id}
>
  <RunSummary run={run} />
</Drawer>

components.name: Tabs
components.summary: Underline tabs with a sliding indicator, optional icons and count badges. Base UI Tabs: roving focus, Home and End, linked panels.
use: Switching between views of the same object or page section.
avoid: Two to five view modes of one list (cards, list): SegmentedControl.
Steps in a flow: Steps.
components.example:
<Tabs label="Workspace views" items={[{ value: 'runs', label: 'Runs', count: 128 }, { value: 'policies', label: 'Policies' }]}>
  <TabPanel value="runs">...</TabPanel>
  <TabPanel value="policies">...</TabPanel>
</Tabs>

components.name: SegmentedControl
components.summary: One choice among 2 to 5 options with a sliding thumb; icon-only for view toggles (cards, list, timeline). Base UI RadioGroup.
use: View modes of one list.
A short exclusive filter (24h, 7 days, 30 days).
avoid: More than 5 options: Select.
Switching content sections: Tabs.
On or off: Switch.
components.example:
<SegmentedControl
  label="View"
  iconOnly
  options={[{ value: 'cards', label: 'Cards', icon: LayoutGrid }, { value: 'list', label: 'List', icon: List }]}
  value={view}
  onValueChange={setView}
/>

components.name: Banner
components.summary: A persistent message about the surface it sits in. Tones info, success, warning, danger; inline or page-level; optional action and dismiss. Merges Alert and Notice.
use: A failed save, a degraded connection, a plan limit, a read-only notice.
avoid: Transient confirmations: Toast.
A region with nothing to show: EmptyState or ErrorState.
Field validation: the Field error.
components.example:
<Banner tone="warning" title="Approaching limit." action={<Button size="sm">See plans</Button>}>
  82% of this month's run quota is used.
</Banner>

components.name: Toast
components.summary: Transient notifications, bottom right, on Base UI Toast: tones, one action, auto-dismiss that pauses on hover and focus, polite or assertive announcements.
use: Confirming an action that happened (saved, archived, copied).
Offering Undo right after an undoable action.
avoid: Persistent problems: Banner.
Anything the user must act on: Dialog or Banner.
components.example:
const toast = useToast();
toast.show({ title: 'Run archived', action: { label: 'Undo', onClick: restore } });

components.name: Skeleton
components.summary: Loading placeholders shaped like the content: text lines, avatar, list row, card and table row. Pulses on a token period, still under reduced motion.
use: Loads over about 300ms where the layout is known.
avoid: Short loads: show nothing.
An in-progress label: Shimmer.
A button action: Button busy.
components.example: <Skeleton variant="table-row" count={5} label="Loading runs" />

components.name: Shimmer
components.summary: Text with a highlight band sweeping across it, for in-progress labels such as "Thinking" or "Running plan".
use: A status label for work that is happening now (assistant thinking, a plan step running).
avoid: Placeholders for content: Skeleton.
A control waiting on a request: Button busy.
components.example: <Shimmer>Thinking</Shimmer>

components.name: EmptyState
components.summary: What a region shows when it has nothing to show: icon, title, body, primary and secondary actions; page and inline sizes.
use: First run, no filter matches, a cleared inbox.
avoid: A failed load: ErrorState.
Loading: Skeleton.
components.example:
<EmptyState
  icon={ShieldCheck}
  title="No policies yet"
  body="Policies decide what your agents may do."
  primaryAction={<Button variant="primary" leading={Plus}>New policy</Button>}
/>

components.name: ErrorState
components.summary: A region that failed to load, with a retry. Same anatomy as EmptyState with a danger glyph; announced on mount.
use: A list, chart or panel whose data request failed.
Permission denied for a region (no retry, a secondary action).
avoid: A failed action on a page that still works: Banner or Toast.
components.example: <ErrorState title="Could not load runs" body="The runs service did not answer." retrying={isFetching} onRetry={refetch} />

components.name: Field
components.summary: The label, hint and error frame around one control. Wires id, aria-describedby, aria-invalid, required, disabled and read-only into the control through context.
use: Every form control that needs a visible label.
Group controls (RadioGroup, OTPInput) with group, so the label names the group.
avoid: Checkbox and Switch rows: they carry their own label and description.
A search box in a toolbar: SearchField with aria-label.
components.example:
<Field label="Email" hint="We send run alerts here." error={error} required>
  <TextInput type="email" />
</Field>

components.name: TextInput
components.summary: Single-line text input with decorative leading and trailing slots, an interactive action slot, busy, mono and three sizes that match Button heights.
use: Short free text: names, emails, URLs, ids.
Inside a Field for labeled forms.
avoid: Multi-line text: Textarea.
Secrets: PasswordInput.
Filtering a list: SearchField.
components.example: <TextInput leading={AtSign} placeholder="name@company.com" />

components.name: PasswordInput
components.summary: TextInput for secrets with a reveal toggle (IconButton, aria-pressed) pinned at the end.
use: Sign in, sign up, reset password, secret entry.
avoid: Showing an existing secret to copy: CopyField.
components.example:
<Field label="Password" required>
  <PasswordInput size="lg" autoComplete="new-password" />
</Field>

components.name: Textarea
components.summary: Multi-line text input with the TextInput box and states, plus autosize up to maxRows.
use: Descriptions, notes, prompts, JSON.
variant="bare" inside a composite input whose well is the box (ChatComposer).
avoid: Single-line values: TextInput.
The chat composer: Composer (Phase 3) builds on this.
components.example: <Textarea autosize maxRows={8} placeholder="Describe the policy" />

components.name: Select
components.summary: Pick one value from a short list. Base UI Select with the TextInput box as trigger and an overlay list that portals, flips and copies the trigger theme.
use: One choice from about 4 to 15 options.
avoid: Two or three visible options: RadioGroup or SegmentedControl.
Long or searchable lists: a Combobox (later).
Actions: Menu.
components.example:
<Field label="Default model">
  <Select options={models} placeholder="Choose a model" />
</Field>

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: A binary choice with an indeterminate state for parents. Base UI Checkbox, 16px box with a 24px hit area, label and description.
use: Independent options in a form.
Row selection in tables (box only with aria-label).
avoid: An immediate setting: Switch.
One of several: RadioGroup.
components.example: <Checkbox label="Notify on block" defaultChecked />

components.name: RadioGroup
components.summary: One choice from a short visible set. RadioGroup plus Radio on Base UI: one tab stop, arrow keys, vertical or horizontal.
use: Two to six mutually exclusive options that should stay visible.
avoid: Many options: Select.
A view switch in a toolbar: SegmentedControl.
components.example:
<Field group label="Retention">
  <RadioGroup defaultValue="30">
    <Radio value="30" label="30 days" />
    <Radio value="90" label="90 days" />
  </RadioGroup>
</Field>

components.name: Switch
components.summary: An immediate on or off setting. Base UI Switch, 32x20 track; the thumb position carries the state; label at start or end.
use: Settings that apply at once, without Save.
avoid: A choice submitted with a form: Checkbox.
components.example: <Switch label="Block on violation" labelPlacement="start" defaultChecked />

components.name: OTPInput
components.summary: A short numeric code, one digit per cell, built on Base UI OTP Field: auto-advance, paste and SMS autofill, a hidden form input, an error shake and an announced busy lock.
use: Email or SMS verification, MFA codes.
avoid: Alphanumeric or long tokens: TextInput mono.
components.example:
<Field group label="Verification code" error={error}>
  <OTPInput onComplete={verify} invalid={!!error} busy={verifying} />
</Field>

components.name: PasswordStrength
components.summary: Advisory strength meter (4 segments plus a word) and a rule checklist under a PasswordInput.
use: Sign up and reset password.
avoid: Sign in.
components.example:
<PasswordInput value={pw} onChange={...} />
<PasswordStrength password={pw} />

components.name: SearchField
components.summary: Query input with a search glyph, a clear button that fades in, Escape to clear, an optional shortcut hint and a filled sidebar variant.
use: Filtering a list or table.
The sidebar search trigger (variant sidebar).
avoid: The global command search UI: CommandPalette (Phase 3).
components.example: <SearchField aria-label="Search runs" value={q} onValueChange={setQ} shortcut={['mod', 'k']} />

components.name: CopyButton
components.summary: Copies text. The glyph cross-fades to a check (or an alert if the clipboard is denied) and back; an always-mounted live region announces it.
use: Commands, keys, ids, code.
avoid: A value the user should see in a field: CopyField.
components.example: <CopyButton value={command} label="Copy command" display="label" variant="secondary" />

components.name: CopyField
components.summary: A read-only value plus a CopyButton, with a mono option for keys and commands. Focus selects the whole value.
use: API keys, install commands, webhook URLs, ids.
avoid: Editable values: TextInput.
Multi-line code: a CodeBlock (later).
components.example:
<Field label="API key">
  <CopyField value={key} mono copyLabel="Copy API key" />
</Field>

components.name: LineChart
components.summary: One to four series over ordered categories, with nice ticks, a crosshair tooltip on hover and arrow keys, and a hidden table as the text alternative. Hand rolled SVG, no chart library.
use: Change over time on one shared scale (Analytics Model Usage).
Up to four series; series 1 is the primary metric.
avoid: One number with a trend: StatTile with a Sparkline.
Magnitude by category: BarChart.
Two measures on different scales: two charts, never a second axis.
components.example: <LineChart title="Model usage" categories={days} series={[{ id: 'opus', label: 'Claude Opus 4.8', data }]} />

components.name: BarChart
components.summary: Magnitude by category with flat bars from one baseline, one optional highlighted bar in the accent, a tooltip on hover and arrow keys, and a hidden table.
use: Comparing a handful of categories on one measure (Cost per Agent).
avoid: Time series: LineChart.
Signed values: a diverging chart (not built).
Shares of one whole: MeterBar or ProgressRing.
components.example: <BarChart title="Cost per agent" data={costs} highlight="Debugging" formatValue={usd} />

components.name: Sparkline
components.summary: A word-sized trend line with no axes: 2px stroke, optional area wash and end dot. Decorative unless labeled.
use: Beside a number in a StatTile, table cell or card.
avoid: When exact values matter: LineChart.
components.example: <Sparkline data={fires} label="Fires, last 30 days" />

components.name: StatTile
components.summary: One headline number with label, signed delta, caption and an optional sparkline. Bezel variant for Analytics KPIs, compact for the Home briefing.
use: A row of KPIs above charts.
Briefing stats with a period comparison.
avoid: More than one number per tile: KeyValueList.
A ratio of a whole: ProgressRing.
components.example: <StatTile label="Cost / successful task" value="$0.0613" delta={{ value: '-5.8%', trend: 'down', goodWhen: 'down' }} caption="p95 vs prior half" />

components.name: MeterBar
components.summary: A bounded value as a bar: segmented ticks for ordinal scales (risk, strictness) or a continuous track (latency, share). role meter.
use: Policy risk and strictness in rows and property strips.
Latency or share beside a mono value in a table cell.
avoid: Task progress over time: a progress bar (not built).
A share as the headline: ProgressRing.
components.example: <MeterBar label="Risk" value={7} max={9} segments={9} tone="auto" />

components.name: ProgressRing
components.summary: A share of a whole as a ring with the percent in the middle and an optional caption (the 61 percent governed stat).
use: One headline ratio in a chat answer or summary card, paired with a KeyValueList.
avoid: Several ratios side by side: MeterBar rows compare better.
components.example: <ProgressRing value={61} tone="warning" label="Governed runs" caption="governed" />

components.name: KeyValueList
components.summary: Term and value pairs as a real description list: stacked eyebrow terms in a grid, or inline rows with hairlines.
use: Facts in a UserCard, inspector header or ring stat.
avoid: Editable settings: Field rows.
Many records: DataTable.
components.example: <KeyValueList items={[{ term: 'Department', description: 'Executive' }]} />

components.name: CodeBlock
components.summary: Monospace code with an optional header and a copy slot that takes any node. Terminal variant (also exported as CommandCard) for setup commands.
use: Setup commands, tool-call arguments, JSON snippets.
avoid: A single copyable value in a form: CopyField.
Inline code in prose: a code element.
components.example: <CommandCard code={cmd} label="Your agent" copy={<CopyButton value={cmd} display="label" size="sm" />} />

components.name: CommandCard
components.summary: The setup command card: CodeBlock locked to its terminal variant (bordered card, header with label and copy, prompt glyph). Same props as CodeBlock without variant.
use: Setup commands, tool-call arguments, JSON snippets.
avoid: A single copyable value in a form: CopyField.
Inline code in prose: a code element.
components.example: <CommandCard code={cmd} label="Your agent" copy={<CopyButton value={cmd} display="label" size="sm" />} />

components.name: DataTable
components.summary: A dense record table with a sticky header, sortable columns, a checkbox column, hover and open-peek rows, mono numeric columns and loading, empty and error bodies.
use: Runs, users and policy lists.
avoid: Fewer than four fields per record: a list.
Spreadsheet editing: not supported (no grid role).
components.example: <DataTable caption="Runs" columns={columns} rows={runs} getRowId={(r) => r.id} onRowClick={(r) => openPeek(r.id)} activeRowId={peekId} />

components.name: Timeline
components.summary: Swimlanes of time blocks on a shared axis with a now line (Users timeline). Exports Timeline and the single-lane TimelineRow.
use: Who worked on what during a day or week.
avoid: Span timing inside one run: TraceTree with waterfall.
components.example: <Timeline label="Team schedule" lanes={lanes} domain={[9, 21]} ticks={hourTicks} now={{ value: 15.67, label: 'Now 3:40 PM' }} />

components.name: ActivityFeedItem
components.summary: One Home feed row: status tile, title with a provider chip, a body line and right-hand figures. The whole row is one link or button. ActivityFeedGroup adds the dated heading.
use: Approvals, plans and exceptions awaiting a decision.
avoid: Dense comparable records: DataTable.
components.example: <ActivityFeedItem icon={Pause} title="feature-dev" body={summary} status={<StatusBadge tone="warning" variant="solid" size="sm">Held</StatusBadge>} onClick={openPeek} />

components.name: TraceTree
components.summary: A run's spans as an indented ARIA tree with expand and collapse, kind chips, cost, duration, optional waterfall bars and status. Rows are SpanRows.
use: Run detail: the Waterfall tab beside the inspector.
avoid: Flat lists of runs: DataTable.
components.example: <TraceTree label="Trace for support-access" spans={spans} selectedId={spanId} onSelectedIdChange={openInspector} />

components.name: UserCard
components.summary: A person in the Users grid: avatar, name, title, role badge, two facts, contact and an optional attention strip, in a bezel shell.
use: Card view of members.
avoid: List view: DataTable.
A member row in settings: MemberRow (not built).
components.example: <UserCard name="Guy Hawkins" title="Co-Founder" roleBadge={<StatusBadge tone="info" dot>Admin</StatusBadge>} fields={facts} email="guyhaw@armoriq.io" onOpen={openProfile} />

components.name: PolicyCard
components.summary: A suggested detection: mono name, what it catches, severity, evidence and decision buttons.
use: Suggested detections above the policy table.
avoid: Existing policies: DataTable rows.
components.example: <PolicyCard name="external-share-guard" description={why} severity={<StatusBadge tone="danger" size="sm">Block</StatusBadge>} meta="Regex · 2 runs" actions={buttons} />

components.name: NavItem
components.summary: One destination in the sidebar: 28 icon tile, label, optional count. Anchor with href, button without. aria-current marks the page.
use: A route in the NavRail or a nested destination inside a NavGroup.
avoid: Actions that do not navigate: Button or MenuItem.
Switching views inside one page: Tabs or SegmentedControl.
components.example:
<NavList>
  <NavItem icon={Home} label="Home" href="/" current />
  <NavItem icon={Bell} label="Inbox" href="/inbox" count={72} countLabel="72 unread" />
</NavList>

components.name: NavGroup
components.summary: Groups NavItems: a static section with an eyebrow label, or a collapsible parent row (AI Chat threads) on Base UI Collapsible.
use: A destination with children (chat threads).
A labeled section of the rail (Workspace).
avoid: One level of flat destinations: NavItem in NavList.
More than two levels: rethink the IA.
components.example:
<NavGroup collapsible label="AI Chat" icon={MessageSquare} current={inChat}>
  <NavItem label="Refund agent review" href="/chat/1" />
</NavGroup>

components.name: NavRail
components.summary: The 248 app sidebar on surface-chrome: header, search trigger, a scrolling list of destinations, and a footer with Inbox and Settings.
use: The primary navigation of the console shell.
avoid: Settings sub-navigation inside a dialog: SettingsNav.
In-page sections: Tabs.
components.example:
<NavRail header={<Wordmark />} search={<CommandPalette items={commands} trigger={<CommandPaletteTrigger />} bindShortcut />} footer={<NavList><NavItem icon={Bell} label="Inbox" href="/inbox" count={72} /></NavList>}>
  <NavList>
    <NavIte

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.summary: Ordered trail in a nav landmark. The last item is the page (aria-current). Long trails fold the middle into a menu; segments truncate at crumb-max. Items can render OrgSwitcher and ProjectSwitcher.
use: Top bar scope (org / project) and deep pages (policy, run, span).
avoid: A one-level page: the PageHeader title is enough.
Steps in a flow: Steps.
components.example: <Breadcrumb items={[{ label: 'Policies', href: '/policies' }, { label: 'Refund agent cap' }]} />

components.name: OrgSwitcher
components.summary: Top bar control for the active organization: square avatar, name, plan tag and a menu of orgs as radio rows with a create action.
use: Switching the active organization from the top bar breadcrumb.
avoid: Choosing a value in a form: Select.
components.example: <OrgSwitcher options={[{ id: 'ash', name: "Ash's Organization", tag: 'Hobby' }]} value={id} onValueChange={setId} onCreate={openCreate} />

components.name: ProjectSwitcher
components.summary: Top bar control for the active project inside the org: name and a menu of projects as radio rows with a create action.
use: Switching the active project from the top bar breadcrumb.
avoid: Choosing a value in a form: Select.
components.example: <ProjectSwitcher options={[{ id: 'my', name: 'My Project' }]} value={id} onValueChange={setId} onCreate={openCreate} />

components.name: AccountMenu
components.summary: The signed-in user in the top bar: avatar (and name) trigger, a menu with an identity header, app rows, an optional Theme submenu and Sign out.
use: The right end of the top bar.
avoid: Org or project switching: OrgSwitcher, ProjectSwitcher.
components.example:
<AccountMenu user={{ name: 'Ashutosh Rana', email: 'ashutosh@armoriq.io' }} theme={theme} onThemeChange={setTheme} onSignOut={signOut}>
  <MenuItem icon={User}>Profile</MenuItem>
</AccountMenu>

components.name: PageHeader
components.summary: Top of a page: optional breadcrumb, h1 title (title-lg), description, status meta, and right-aligned actions that wrap under the title when space runs out.
use: Every console page.
avoid: Card or section headings: plain headings in the card.
Dialog titles: Dialog.
components.example: <PageHeader title="Policies" description="Rules every agent run is checked against." actions={<Button variant="primary" leading={Plus}>New policy</Button>} />

components.name: CommandPalette
components.summary: Mod+K search and jump. Base UI Dialog around a combobox and grouped listbox: arrow keys move the active option, Enter runs it, Escape closes. Loading, empty and error states, Kbd hints footer.
use: Global navigation and actions from anywhere in the console.
avoid: Filtering one list: SearchField.
Picking a form value: Select.
components.example: <CommandPalette items={[{ id: 'runs', label: 'Runs', group: 'Pages', onSelect: () => go('/runs') }]} trigger={<CommandPaletteTrigger />} bindShortcut />

components.name: StreamingText
components.summary: Text that arrives in chunks: new chunks fade in and an accent caret pulses at the end while streaming.
use: Plain text that grows token by token: a tool log line, a one-line status, a generated title.
avoid: Formatted answers: Markdown with streaming (same caret).
In-progress labels with no text yet: Shimmer.
components.example: <StreamingText text={partial} streaming={!done} />

components.name: Markdown
components.summary: Renders assistant Markdown (headings, lists, inline code, fenced code through CodeBlock, tables, quotes, links) with a hand parser and no HTML pass.
use: Assistant answers and any model-written text.
avoid: Authored docs with nested lists or footnotes: the subset is chat-sized.
User turns: show them as plain text.
components.example: <Markdown source={answer} streaming={isStreaming} />

components.name: ChatMessage
components.summary: One chat turn: a right-aligned user bubble or full-width assistant prose, optional avatar, and an actions row (copy, retry, thumbs).
use: Every turn in an assistant thread.
avoid: Comments or activity: ActivityFeedItem.
Tool output on its own: ToolCallRow or EvidenceCard inside the assistant turn.
components.example:
<ChatMessage role="assistant" author="ArmorAI" copyText={answer} onRetry={retry}>
  <Markdown source={answer} />
</ChatMessage>

components.name: ChatComposer
components.summary: The chat input: a bezel with an autosizing text box, context and attachment chips, attach, mode toggles, a model picker and Send or Stop.
use: The landing hero composer and the docked thread composer.
avoid: Form fields that happen to be multi-line: Textarea.
Search: SearchField.
components.example: <ChatComposer variant="landing" models={models} tools={tools} onAttach={pick} onSubmit={send} busy={streaming} onStop={stop} />

components.name: EvidenceCard
components.summary: A tool result cited inside an answer: an inset card with a title, a "View all" action and a few linked EvidenceRows.
use: Up to about five records that back an assistant claim.
avoid: Full result sets: DataTable behind "View all".
A single fact: CitationChip inline.
components.example:
<EvidenceCard title="Blocked runs" action={<Link href="/runs">View all</Link>}>
  <EvidenceRow title="docs" meta="Sam Cole · 14d ago" value="7.2K" href="/runs/docs" />
</EvidenceCard>

components.name: CitationChip
components.summary: Inline numbered citation in assistant prose that links to its source and names it in a tooltip.
use: A claim in an answer that rests on a specific record or document.
avoid: Several records at once: EvidenceCard.
components.example: <CitationChip index={1} source="Run docs" href="/runs/docs" />

components.name: SuggestionChips
components.summary: Prompt starters or follow-ups as wrapping secondary Buttons.
use: Generic starters under an empty composer.
Follow-up questions after an answer.
avoid: Suggestions driven by live workspace state: SuggestionList.
components.example: <SuggestionChips label="Prompt starters" items={starters} onSelect={(s) => send(s.prompt ?? s.label)} />

components.name: SuggestionList
components.summary: State-driven suggestion rows for the chat landing: tone glyph, bold lead word, one line of context.
use: Landing suggestions generated from workspace state (briefing, held, drift, budget).
avoid: Generic prompt starters: SuggestionChips.
components.example: <SuggestionList label="Suggested questions" items={signals} onSelect={ask} />

components.name: ToolCallRow
components.summary: One tool call inside an assistant turn: status glyph, mono tool name, summary, duration, and a disclosure for arguments and result.
use: Showing what the agent did while answering.
avoid: Run traces with nesting and timing: TraceTree.
components.example: <ToolCallRow name="search_runs" status="success" summary="Found 2 blocked runs" duration="1.2s" args={args} result={result} />

components.name: ChatEmptyLanding
components.summary: The chat landing hero: greeting and question over the composer, then suggestions and an optional stat strip, in the 700px chat measure.
use: The empty state of a chat surface before the first turn.
avoid: Empty lists and tables: EmptyState.
components.example: <ChatEmptyLanding greeting="Good morning." title="How can I help you today?" composer={<ChatComposer variant="landing" />} suggestions={<SuggestionList label="Suggested questions" items={signals} />} />

components.name: Steps
components.summary: A vertical sequence of done, current and upcoming steps joined by a rail; the current step opens its content.
use: First-run setup and any ordered flow where the user sees all steps at once.
avoid: Multi-page wizards with Back and Next: use Dialog steps or routes.
Unordered task lists: use a ListGroup with Checkboxes.
components.example: <Steps label="Setup steps" steps={[{ id: 'install', status: 'done', title: 'Install' }, { id: 'key', status: 'current', title: 'Create a key', content: <Button>Create key</Button> }]} />

components.name: SetupChecklist
components.summary: First-run setup: heading, progress meter, Steps, and a completion slot so the page never dead-ends.
use: Empty home or Runs page before the first run arrives.
avoid: Feature tours or tooltips.
components.example: <SetupChecklist title="Get your first run" steps={steps} action={<Button size="sm" variant="ghost">Skip setup</Button>} complete={<EmptyState ... />} />

components.name: ListToolbar
components.summary: The bar above a list or table: search, filters, count, view switch and actions in one row of 32px controls.
use: Above DataTable, card grids and timelines.
avoid: Page-level title and primary action: PageHeader.
components.example: <ListToolbar label="Runs filters" search={<SearchField size="sm" />} filters={<FilterBar ... />} count="128 runs" view={<ViewToggle />} actions={<Button size="sm">New</Button>} />

components.name: FilterBar
components.summary: Toolbar filter pills (Button sm, drawn on while applied, with a remove button) plus Clear all.
use: Facet filters above a list.
avoid: Tags inside content or inputs: Chip.
components.example: <FilterBar activeCount={1} onClearAll={clear}><Menu trigger={<FilterPill label="Agent" value="billing-bot" onRemove={clearAgent} />}>...</Menu></FilterBar>

components.name: ViewToggle
components.summary: Switch a collection between cards, list, table and timeline: an icon-only SegmentedControl preset.
use: Users, Runs and Plans where the same rows render as cards, list or timeline.
avoid: Switching between different content: Tabs.
components.example: <ViewToggle value={view} onValueChange={setView} />

components.name: Pagination
components.summary: Range text plus previous, page and next buttons, with ellipses for long ranges.
use: Table and list footers with known totals.
avoid: Feeds: load more or infinite scroll.
components.example: <Pagination total={128} pageSize={10} page={page} onPageChange={setPage} noun="runs" />

components.name: SettingsNav
components.summary: The settings master list: grouped sections, a filter field, and the selected section marked current.
use: Inside SettingsLayout.
avoid: App navigation: NavRail.
components.example: <SettingsNav groups={[{ label: 'Account', items: [{ value: 'profile', label: 'Profile', icon: User }] }]} value={section} onValueChange={setSection} />

components.name: SettingsLayout
components.summary: Settings as master-detail: SettingsNav column plus SettingsPanel, as a page or a 1080 wide modal.
use: Account and workspace settings.
avoid: A single short form: Dialog.
components.example: <SettingsLayout variant="modal" trigger={<Button>Settings</Button>} meta="ArmorIQ · Team" nav={<SettingsNav ... />}><SettingsPanel title="API Keys">...</SettingsPanel></SettingsLayout>

components.name: ListGroup
components.summary: A bordered list of rows with hairlines between them; renders an empty slot in the same frame at zero rows.
use: Short settings lists: keys, members, runs a policy fired on.
avoid: Sortable, columnar data: DataTable.
components.example: <ListGroup label="API keys" empty={<EmptyState size="inline" title="No keys yet" />}>{keys.map((k) => <ApiKeyRow key={k.id} {...k} />)}</ListGroup>

components.name: ApiKeyRow
components.summary: One API key: name, scope, masked key, permissions, created, last used, and Revoke.
use: Settings, API Keys.
avoid: Showing a freshly created secret: CopyField in a Dialog.
components.example: <ApiKeyRow name="Production CI" prefix="aq_live_" last4="4f2a" scope="all" permissions={['runs:read']} created="42d ago" lastUsed="12d ago" onRevoke={confirm} />

components.name: MemberRow
components.summary: One workspace member: avatar, name, email, role Select or badge, invite pending, remove.
use: Settings, Members & Access.
avoid: Directory browsing: UserCard or DataTable.
components.example: <MemberRow name="Priya Shah" email="priya@armoriq.io" role={role} roles={roles} onRoleChange={setRole} onRemove={confirm} />

components.name: AuthCard
components.summary: The sign in and sign up column: title, providers, "or" divider, form, switch link and legal; AuthLayout frames it with a wordmark and art panel.
use: Sign in, sign up, reset password.
avoid: In-app forms: Dialog or SettingsPanel.
components.example: <AuthCard title="Welcome back" providers={<OAuthButton provider="github" />} onSubmit={signIn} footer={<>No account? <Link href="/signup">Sign up</Link></>}>...</AuthCard>

components.name: OAuthButton
components.summary: Continue with Google, GitHub, Microsoft or SSO: Button secondary lg with a single-color brand mark.
use: Auth screens.
avoid: Connecting an integration inside the app: Button with the provider mark.
components.example: <OAuthButton provider="github" onClick={startOAuth} />

components.name: AuthDivider
components.summary: The "or" rule between provider buttons and the email form.
use: Inside AuthCard (it renders one for you).
avoid: Section breaks in content: Divider.
components.example: <AuthDivider />

components.name: AuthLayout
components.summary: Full-page auth frame: wordmark top left, the AuthCard anchored to a fixed top offset, and an optional decorative art panel on the right (hidden below lg).
use: Sign in, sign up, forgot and reset password, verify email.
avoid: In-app forms: use a page or a Dialog.
components.example: <AuthLayout brand={<Wordmark />} art={<AuthArt />}><AuthCard ... /></AuthLayout>

components.name: BriefingCard
components.summary: The home briefing: caps title, mono lead, headline and titled BriefingSections, read like a note.
use: Home, start of day.
avoid: Live feeds: ActivityFeedItem.
components.example: <BriefingCard title="Daily briefing" lead="Tue, Jul 1 · 12 runs overnight" headline="Three runs need a decision."><BriefingSection eyebrow="Approvals" title="3 runs wait on you">...</BriefingSection></BriefingCard>

components.name: StatStrip
components.summary: Two to four numbers in one bordered strip separated by hairlines.
use: Chat answers and page headers that need a compact KPI row.
avoid: Dashboard KPIs with sparklines: StatTile.
components.example: <StatStrip items={[{ id: 'runs', label: 'Runs', value: '1,284', delta: { value: '16.7%', trend: 'up' } }]} />

components.name: MetricChip
components.summary: A labelled number for header strips ("Tokens 12.4K", "Drift 72%"), with warning and danger tones.
use: Run detail and inspector headers.
avoid: Status words: StatusBadge.
Removable tags: Chip.
components.example: <MetricChip label="Drift" value="72%" tone="danger" />

components.name: Accordion
components.summary: Stacked disclosure cards; each header button opens its body. Base UI Accordion.
use: Long detail pages split into sections (policy detail).
avoid: Navigation between views: Tabs.
Hiding required form fields.
components.example: <Accordion defaultValue={['when']} items={[{ value: 'when', title: 'When it fires', meta: '2 rules', content: <RuleRow ... /> }]} />

components.name: RuleRow
components.summary: One policy condition, field, operator and value in mono ("span.tool is add_member").
use: Policy detail, When it fires.
avoid: Editing conditions: a form with Select and TextInput.
components.example: <RuleRow field="span.tool" op="is" value="add_member" />

components.name: ToolPermissionTile
components.summary: One tool and the policy decision on it: name, description, Allow, Flag, Hold or Block.
use: Policy detail, Tool permissions.
avoid: Runtime tool calls: ToolCallRow.
components.example: <ToolPermissionTile name="add_member" description="Adds a user." decision="hold" />

components.name: PropertyStrip
components.summary: A detail page's key properties in one wrapping line: an inline definition list.
use: Under a detail page header.
avoid: Many properties: KeyValueList.
components.example: <PropertyStrip items={[{ id: 'decision', label: 'Decision', value: <StatusBadge tone="danger" size="sm" dot>Deny</StatusBadge> }]} />

components.name: RunBarList
components.summary: A ranked list whose rows carry a proportional bar behind the text: a bar chart that keeps labels readable.
use: Top runs, agents or tools by a count.
avoid: Time series: LineChart.
components.example: <RunBarList label="Runs it fired on" items={[{ id: '1', label: 'run_8f2a91', meta: <Chip>billing-bot</Chip>, trailing: '2h ago', value: 14, valueText: '14 fires', href: '/runs/8f2a91' }]} />

components.name: EventCard
components.summary: The expanded form of a Timeline event: title, status, meta, body columns and actions on an overlay surface.
use: Timeline event detail in place.
avoid: Full run detail: a page or Drawer.
components.example: <EventCard title="Reconcile June ledgers" status={<StatusBadge tone="info" size="sm">On track</StatusBadge>} meta={['9:00 to 11:30']} sections={sections} actions={actions} onCollapse={collapse} />
